summary: Day after the -4.4% liquidation, NFP at 08:30. Pre-market 07:43 ET: SPY +0.3% (735.2 vs 733.00), QQQ +1.7%, SMH +5.4% (AMD +8%, MU +9%, LRCX +12% on a $25B buyback, TSM +7%, AVGO +5%, NVDA +4%) while Asia's chips were crushed overnight (Kospi -6% with a circuit breaker, Nikkei -6%, Taiex -4%, Advantest -12%, Kioxia -14%): the US chain is bouncing against its own overnight. The other side of the rotation is reversing too: COST -1.7%, WMT -2.5%, HD -2.2%, LLY -0.9%, UNH -1.9%, XLP -1.9%, XLV -1.3% pre-market, VIXY -2.8%, TLT -0.3%, dollar +0.4%, WTI ~$89-90 (-0.5%). 08:30: payrolls +165K vs +65K (private +159K vs +64K), unemployment 4.1% vs 4.2%, hourly earnings +0.4% m/m / +3.1% y/y vs +0.3% / +2.9%: a hot print, bonds sold (TLT -0.7%), dollar +0.5%, equities unmoved in the first minute (SPY +0.2%, QQQ +1.6%, SMH +5.0%, VIXY -1.6%). Strong jobs plus hotter wages into a market that just sold AI capex and prices a December hike: the bounce has a yields headwind and a short-covering tailwind. p_up 0.50, none.

Platforms and defensives: AAPL -1.2%, MSFT -0.6%, GOOGL -0.1%, META flat, AMZN +0.4%, TSLA +1.5%, COST -1.7%, WMT -2.5%, HD -2.2%, LLY -0.9%, UNH -1.9%, JPM -0.7%, V -1.9%.

Overnight: Asia sold the US rout a day late (Kospi -6% after -8.8% intraday and a 20-minute halt, Nikkei -6%, Taiex -3.8 to -4.5%, TSMC -4 to -5% in Taipei, SK Hynix -11.7%, Advantest -12%, Tokyo Electron -7%, Kioxia -14%; Taiwan imposed a short-selling limit). US futures mixed: S&P +0.3 to +0.4%, Nasdaq-100 +1.7%, Dow -0.9% (Yahoo / CNBC snapshots, not live quotes). Europe lower at the open after the chip rout. The divergence (Asia chips -6 to -12%, US chip ADRs +5 to +12%) is the first sign the chain is loosening; it is also exactly what a short-covering bounce looks like.

08:31 ET re-read after the print: SPY 734.48 (+0.20%, same as before 08:30), QQQ 657.15 (+1.56%), SMH 470.30 (+5.0%), IWM +0.25%, VIXY 20.89 (-1.6%), TLT 81.39 (-0.66%, was -0.34% before the print: yields up on the number), UUP +0.47%, XLV -1.8%, XLP -2.0%, XLF -1.0%. Mega caps: NVDA 189.2 (+4.2%), AMD 436.0 (+7.8%), MU 705 (+7.4%), AVGO +4.9%, META flat, AAPL -1.1%, MSFT -1.0%, AMZN +0.3%, TSLA +2.0%, LLY 1352.0 (-0.9%), UNH -1.5%, COST -1.6%, JPM -0.7%, ORCL 119.4 (+3.6%), HIMS +8.2%. The print did not move stocks in its first minute; it moved bonds and the dollar. Hot wages (+0.4% m/m, +3.1% y/y) with the market already pricing a December hike (71% on 10-30) is the headwind to the bounce; strong hiring (+165K, U3 4.1%) is the growth-scare relief. Net: no edge, p_up 0.50.

08:30 ET: October payrolls (consensus +59K Dow Jones / +65K Bloomberg and FactSet, unemployment 4.2%, ADP was +86K, Pantheon 100K, Vanguard 120K; September +29K). The print is read before the final call: a hot number lifts yields into a market that sold AI capex, a weak one feeds the growth scare; neither obviously helps the bounce. 10:00 Michigan sentiment (prelim). Fed speakers: none confirmed. CPI 11-10 (Tuesday) is the next release in config/macro_events.json; today is an NFP event day, so spy_open_drive, spy_open_drive_put, stock_open_drive, rebound_scanner and leader_follow do not trade (days: non_event).

Day-after base rates: SPY closed up 54% of the time the day after a >= 3% drop (the other Claude's 2005+ table; baseline 55%) and moved >= 1% either way 65% of the time (baseline 25%); with VIX near 28 and payrolls at 08:30 the move will be large, its sign is not knowable from here. OVERNIGHT.md: the night move barely predicts open to close (SPY corr -0.11); the one weak SPY lean (night down >= 0.3% then pre-market recovery >= 0.2%) does not apply, the night was up.

Why the bounce is not a call: it is concentrated in the turning theme (THEMES: chips turning with REL_WEAK, BREADTH, RATIO_LOW, PERIPH; power and optical turning) while the heating themes (health, consumer) are being sold pre-market, so the index is split again (SPY +0.3% vs QQQ +1.7%). Turning-theme gap-ups closed up 56-60% historically (THEMES.md), a coin flip with fat tails. Yesterday's lesson (LOCKGATE.md): the 10:00 structure does not predict the close either way; p_up near 0.50 is honest, the call needs 0.60.

Rates, oil, dollar: 10Y about 4.90% (fell as a haven bid came in Thursday; the exact overnight change in bp could not be confirmed from a dated source; TLT -0.3% pre-market says yields are up a touch this morning), 2Y about 4.6%. WTI $89-90 (-0.5%; USO -0.5%) after +1.9% Thursday, Brent ~$98, oil stopped being the story this week. DXY 101.4 (+0.3%, UUP +0.45%). VIX 28 at Thursday's close; VIXY -2.8% pre-market.

META flat (DOSSIER_META: small gaps fill).

Reports: VST (07:05, beat; power theme turning; reaction day, excluded), IREN (+18%, Microsoft delivery delay headline too), NET (+21%), ABNB (+13%), TEAM (-15%), AXON (-9%), MCHP (flat after -14%), LITE (+10% pre-market after its print and -19% day; optical turning; reaction day) are all reaction-day names and excluded from picks. QCOM and ARM reported 11-04 after the close (two sessions ago, allowed by the rule but no own news today). NVDA reports 11-17 (7 sessions; turning theme, no pre-earnings-drift call).
Night session (Webull overnight, 20:00-04:00 ET) was not snapshotted separately this morning; the extended-hours quotes above are 07:43 ET pre-market.

Friday weekly expiry = same-day options. catalyst_open buys a ~0.10-delta same-day call 09:31-10:00 only while LLY holds its open; half at 3x, trail from 1.5x; may carry overnight. Risks: the rotation unwind (LLY gave a +2.3% new high back to -4.8% open to close on 11-05) and a payrolls tape; a distribution deal is a weak catalyst (target-raise class), hence 0.35. 08:31 re-read: LLY 1352.0 (-0.9%, unchanged by the print), HIMS +8.2% on the same news; XLV -1.8% pre-market, so the sector is the risk, not the name.

zh.summary: 大跌 4.4% 的次日，08:30 非农。盘前 07:43：标普 ETF +0.3%，纳指 ETF +1.7%，半导体 ETF +5.4%（AMD +8%、美光 +9%、泛林 +12% 回购、台积电 +7%、博通 +5%、英伟达 +4%），而亚洲芯片股昨夜被砸（韩国 -6% 熔断、日本 -6%、台湾 -4%）：美国这条链在逆着自己的隔夜反弹。轮动的另一头也在倒：好市多 -1.7%、沃尔玛 -2.5%、家得宝 -2.2%、礼来 -0.9%、联合健康 -1.9%，恐慌指数 ETF -2.8%，美元 +0.4%，油 -0.5%。转向主题里的第二天空头回补，赶上非农早晨，方向是硬币。 08:30 非农偏热（+16.5 万、时薪 +0.4%），债跌美元涨，股票第一分钟没动。
zh.spy: 不做。上涨概率 50%：08:30 非农 +16.5 万（预期 +6.5 万），失业率 4.1%，时薪环比 +0.4%、同比 +3.1%，都偏热。债券被卖、美元涨，股票第一分钟没动（标普 +0.2%、纳指 +1.6%、半导体 +5%）。就业强是对增长担忧的安慰，工资热在一个本来就在定价 12 月加息的市场里是逆风；大跌次日的回补又只在芯片里。两边抵消，没到 60% 的看涨线也没到 40% 的看跌线。
zh.sniper: 礼来看涨，信心 0.35。06:49 礼来宣布和 Hims & Hers 合作，Zepbound（每月 299 美元）和口服减肥药 Foundayo（149 美元）上对方平台按标准自付价卖，是两天里第二个分销渠道（昨天是 LifeMD）。盘前 -0.9%，消息还没进价格；医疗主题在升温，是今天唯一有消息的升温主题大盘股；目标价中位 1,508。风险：轮动倒回来的日子防守股被卖（昨天礼来从新高吐回 -4.8%），分销合作是弱催化剂。机器人只在 09:31 到 10:00、股价守住开盘价时买当天到期的看涨，3 倍卖一半。
zh.rotation: 一周一月看：钱在消费（沃尔玛、好市多、家得宝一周 +5% 到 +7%，一月 +18%）、医疗（礼来一月 +15%）、必需消费和公用事业 ETF、长债；流出芯片（GPU 一周 -15%、CPU -33%、存储 -35%、硬盘 -33%，半导体 ETF 一周 -20%）、光模块 -39%、电力基建 -17%、能源 -9%。主题状态：芯片、电力、光模块转向（不买看涨）；医疗、消费升温；互联网中性。今早盘面是 11-05 的镜像：芯片涨、防守跌，10 点以后守不守比非农更决定今天。
